Hi Marissa/Eric —

Thanks — summary and answers below (happy to jump on a quick call with Eric/procurement if helpful).

1) SOC 2: attached is the redacted SOC 2 Type II (SOC2-Redwood-2026-redacted.pdf). This covers Security and Availability. If you need additional scopes (e.g., Confidentiality), let me know and we can discuss timelines.

2) SAML / SSO: we support SAML 2.0, both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated. Key details:
   - SP EntityID: urn:redwood:sp:production
   - ACS: https://auth.redwood.com/saml/acs
   - SLO: https://auth.redwood.com/saml/slo
   - Certificate SHA256: 3A:5F:...:9B (full cert provided on request)
   - Attributes we map: email (userPrincipalName), displayName, groups (optional), custom attributes via attribute-mapping config.

Attachment: sso_saml_config_snippet.txt (example metadata + assertion mapping).

3) SCIM: we support SCIM 2.0 (RFC7644) for provisioning/deprovisioning.
   - Base URL: https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2/
   - Supported resources: /Users, /Groups
   - Supported operations: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE; partial PATCH for group membership.
   - Rate limits: 600 reqs/min per org (configurable for Dedicated/Private).
   - Sample provisioning payload is provided in the attached config snippet.

4) RBAC & admin controls:
   - Roles: Organization Admin (billing/keys/config), Security Admin (audit access, logs), Project Admin (model routes, deployments), Read-only Viewer.
   - Key management: customer-managed KMS (available for Private & Dedicated) or Redwood-managed keys for Hosted. Org Admin can rotate API keys and configure KMS.
   - Emergency access: documented break-glass process with audit logging; access reviews quarterly.

Links to artifacts: SOC2 (attached), SSO overview (redwood_sso_overview.pdf), SAML config snippet (sso_saml_config_snippet.txt). Also uploaded a copy to our secure drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-iam-evidence

ETA: we can fill out the majority of the questionnaire and return within 48 business hours; if you need a formal walk-through, happy to schedule.

Regards,

Aditya Rao
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
